# kubernetes

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//kubernetes:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//kubernetes:defs.bzl", "kubernetes_library", "kubernetes_schemas")
```

## Rules

### `kubernetes_library`

Owns the Kubernetes manifests of one package for dx lint (kubeconform).

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Kubernetes manifest files of this package; every document needs apiVersion and kind. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Other manifest libraries this package depends on. |

### `kubernetes_schemas`

Stages offline JSON schemas and the kubeconform settings for dx lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crd_schemas` | `label_keyed_string_dict` | no | CRD schema files named <kind>_<version>.json mapped to their API group. |
| `kubernetes_version` | `string` | yes | Label for the version the schema files describe, as X.Y.Z; the files decide it. |
| `schemas` | `label_list` | no | Core schema files named like kubernetes-json-schema, such as deployment-apps-v1.json. |
| `skip_kinds` | `string_list` | no | Resource kinds kubeconform skips. |
